title: Idempotent-free non-solvable evolution algebras over $\mathbb{C}$
summary: A recent conjecture states that a finite-dimensional complex evolution algebra is solvable if and only if it has no non-zero idempotents. We exhibit a three-dimensional counterexample over $\mathbb{C}$ whose isomorphism class already appears in the classification of three-dimensional complex evolution algebras. Since the conjecture is known in dimensions one and two, this counterexample has the smallest possible dimension.
